data.name: Amalie
data.gender_notes: Amalie is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old German name Amal, meaning ‘work, love, or labor’. The name Amalie was popularized by the German writer Johann Christian Friedrich Hölderlin, who wrote a poem about a woman named Amalia. The name Amalie carries the meaning “Love or to love” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Amalie usually hope their child will grow to embody love or to love and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing the love and devotion of the Christian faith.
data.etymology: Amalie belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Love or to love.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Amalie total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: אמאלי
in_hebrew.meaning: עמל עמי - עבודה שלי, עמלה שלי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם אמאלי נגזר מהמילה העברית 'עמל' שפירושה עבודה או תוצר העבודה. הוא קשור גם למילה 'עמי' שפירושה עמי או עובדי. השם אמאלי יכול להתפרש כ'עבודה שלי' או 'עמלה שלי', ויש לו קונוטציה של עבודה קשה והתמסרות.

in_greek.name: Αμαλία
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αμαλία προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη 'αμαλία', που σημαίνει ανταποδίδω ή ανταπόκριση. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, η λέξη σχετίζεται με την έννοια της ανταπόκρισης ή της απόκρισης στο κάλεσμα του Θεού. Το όνομα Αμαλία φέρει πνευματική σημασία που συνδέεται με την πίστη και την υπακοή.

in_latin.name: Amalie
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Amalie is derived from the Latin words 'amare' meaning to love and 'labor' meaning work. It signifies industriousness and diligence. In Christian tradition, the name Amalie connotes a devoted and hardworking individual, reflecting virtues esteemed in early Christian communities.

in_english.name: Amalie
in_english.long_meaning: The name Amalie originates from Hebrew and Greek roots, signifying industriousness and diligence. It is associated with the concepts of work, devotion, and love. In Christian tradition, Amalie represents a person who is hardworking, devoted, and loving, embodying virtues such as dedication and commitment. Historically, the name has been used across various Christian cultures, symbolizing a strong work ethic and spiritual devotion.
